tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should submit certified copies of the dealer ship and reseller certificate of Ricoh machine as AMC is called for 36 Ricoh machines.

Bidder should submit work order copies of the supply and execution of Xerox toner, cartridge and AMC in last five years for Govt./Semi Govt. various departments and private sectors with value of more than 3 lakhs.
Bidder should submit certified copy of the registration and renewed certificate of GST from commercial tax department and income tax department.
Details of registration from the Labour Department (registration certificate with validity period to be enclosed)

Bidder should submit in Rs. 100 stamp paper, that the firm is a non-black listed and non-defaulted in any central Govt. state Govt. or semi Govt. and public sectors. The black listed person/firm is not allowed for the tender.
Bidder should submit certified copies of the Pan Card and IT returns for the last 03 years.
Bidder should submit past 03 years turn over certificate from registered charted accountant and should have at least 05 lakhs turn over any of the two financial years.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Any other technical documents as per tender documents
